page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Running head at top centre above the text; page number at top right. Body opens with a continuing paragraph, then FINIS, then a large title block with a subtitle and a list of monasteries in single lines. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: uentem sanctifica, qui tres pueros de accensu fornace saluasti. Præsta quæsumus, piissime, si quis innocens de hoc furto vel stupro seu nostræ inquisitionis causa immunis atque indebitor in aquam manum miserit, sicut Susannam de falso crimine liberasti, ita & ipse saluam & inlæsam manum educat. Ita Deus omnipotens, si quis culpabilis ingrauante Diabolo, corde indurato, per aliqua maleficia aut per herbas contegere peccata sua voluerit, tua iustissima hoc veritas in eius corpore declaret & manifestet, ut anima per pœnitentiam sanetur, per tuum unigenitum filium Deum & Dominum nostrum Ihesum Christum, qui tecum viuit & regnat per omnia secula seculorum, amen.
main_text.head: FINIS.
ALAMANNICÆ ECCLESIÆ VETERIS FRATERNITATES.
HÆC SVNT MONASTERIA FRATRVM ET SORORVM per Alamanniam.
main_text.l: Fratribus in Nebidona, id est Spira.

page.notes: The first paragraph is a continuation from the previous page. The large initials of the list lines (P, F, S) are decorated capitals and are joined to their words. Some list lines are partly damaged at the left edge by staining; readings there follow the likely letters. The catchword "Soro." is printed at the lower right.
